description: This file defines the SiloMessagingOptions class, which specifies configuration options related to messaging within an Orleans silo. It includes properties for queue counts, timeouts, request limits, and other runtime behaviors specific to silo messaging configuration.

classes.name: SiloMessagingOptions
classes.description: A class that extends MessagingOptions to include silo-specific messaging configuration settings, such as queue sizes, timeouts, request limits, and other operational parameters.

methods.name: SystemResponseTimeout
methods.description: Property with getter and setter for the system response timeout, with special handling if a debugger is attached.
